global_caption: The video contains 6 shots. It is a short tutorial-style video in high-saturation pixel art style, focusing on a big-eyed little sprite preparing a street stir-fry at a food cart corner in the city during evening hours. The overall tone is unified by warm orange streetlights and slightly cool urban ambient lighting. The emotional tone remains cheerful and soothing.
shot1: Shot 1 opens with a fade-in, using a wide-angle slight overhead composition. The food cart and street corner pavement occupy mid-to-background, the foldable stove centered visually. In the foreground, green peppers, carrots, mushrooms, scallions, and seasoning bottles are neatly arranged. Background features pixelated streetlights, slowly moving vehicle light trails, and sidewalk edges. Leading lines extend from the side of the cart to the stove. Shallow depth of field but full environmental context. Warm streetlight glow creates soft highlights on ingredients. A big-eyed sprite stands behind the stove organizing knife and cutting board. The camera slowly pushes in.
shot2: Shot 2 cuts hard from the previous shot, transitioning to a close-up slight overhead view. Focus centers on the cutting board and hand movements. Foreground shows knife edge and green pepper strips; background blurs out cart edge and seasoning bottles. Tight composition emphasizes instructional clarity. Lighting maintains warm orange tone with pixel reflections on the blade. The sprite chops green peppers first, then carrots, dicing them evenly. Knife movements are sharp and clear, diced pieces gradually piling up on one side of the board. The camera performs a small lateral pan to follow the knife motion.
shot3: Shot 3 cuts hard from the previous shot, using an extreme close-up eye-level slightly low angle. The lens is closer to the blade and ingredient edges. Mushroom caps and scallion segments lie in focus plane. Foreground reveals pixelated wood grain texture of the cutting board; background fully blurred into warm light spots. Warm streetlight continues to cover the subject, supplemented by soft fill light from the cart’s small lamp. The sprite continues prep work: mushrooms sliced uniformly thin, scallions cut into even segments. Each lift and drop of the blade produces tiny pixel sparkles. ambient wind is lowered to highlight operational
shot4: Shot 4 transitions via quick wipe cut to a medium eye-level shot. The stove and pot dominate the frame. Foreground shows pot rim and oil surface reflection; mid-ground features the sprite holding a spatula; background retains pixelated lights from the cart and distant traffic. Warm light illuminates ingredients in the pot, contrasting with the cooler night backdrop. The sprite heats the pan, adds oil, then sequentially pours in diced green peppers, carrots, mushrooms, and scallions. Vegetables quickly move in the pan, shifting from raw texture to glossy freshness. The camera shifts from slight push-in to short tracking along the spatula's stir-fry path.
shot5: Shot 5 cuts hard from the previous shot, using a close-up overhead view. Focus is on changes inside the pot. Foreground shows sauce pouring from a small bottle forming a bright pixelated liquid stream. Mid-ground shows stirred vegetables; background keeps only blurred flames and stove edge. Overall still dominated by warm orange lighting. Steam appears as layered pixel particles under backlighting. The sprite evenly pours sauce into the pot and rapidly stirs. The surface of the dish shifts from dry to richly glazed. Steam continuously rises and briefly obscures the pot rim. The camera performs a small circular pan.
shot6: Shot 6 connects to the previous shot with a subtle fade-in/fade-out transition, using an extreme close-up eye-level slightly upward angle. A roadside small table occupies the foreground center; the plate dominates visual focus. Background features softened cart signage and evening street scene. Shallow depth of field enhances the vibrant colors of the finished dish. Warm streetlight creates clean highlights on the plate edge. The sprite carefully plates the stir-fry and places it on the table. Green peppers, carrots, mushrooms, and scallions are layered distinctly, colors bright and appealing. Light steam continues to rise slowly. The action flows seamlessly from carrying the plate to placing it down. The camera first gently tilts down to follow the plate’s landing point, then makes a very short push-in to settle on the final details.
